gap.title: No linear space of 4 x 5 complex matrices of dimension 7 keeps the sum over row-to-column injections of the product of (1 + entry) equal to 120
gap.statement: ¬ (∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ f : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 5, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 120) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 7)
gap.unlocks: Settles the 4 x 5 level-space question at dimension 7 on the side many provers believe: no such space exists.
gap.context: SKETCH: a space of dimension 7 would make the polynomial (sum over injections from rows to columns of the product of (1 + entry)) minus 120 vanish on a 7-dimensional subspace; expand by degree, each homogeneous part must vanish on the subspace, and bound the dimension of a common zero subspace of the degree-1 and degree-2 parts by exact linear algebra over the rationals. The record has a witness of dimension 6. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration. Namespace: PEqualNP.Gct.
